# Prashant Chataut

Prashant is a developer in Nepal who builds apps for learning, play, and reflection.

## Projects

- [NEBians](https://nebians.consica.com.np/): Study resources, exam updates, and a forum for students and teachers, on the web and Android. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.neb.ians).
- [Retra](https://github.com/prashantchataut/Retra): An Android Game Boy Advance emulator with a custom engine, patcher, and original game, Mochi Hop.
- [Prody](https://github.com/prashantchataut/Prody): A journaling and reflection app without streaks.
